narrative_prose: The First Forge's interior glowed with the ambient heat of captured lightning geodes, casting long shadows across the hand-soldered copper busbars while the low hum of the ferrofluid sea outside vibrated through Silas's boots. Smelling the sharp ozone and tasting the static tang on his tongue, he adjusted the flux-core shielding to CONCEAL the vital components and used the sympathetic ore reserve to ATTRACT loose metallic particles. He worked to DEFEND the delicate condensers from the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea, knowing that even if the calibration faltered, the minor blowouts would only scorch the plating and leave a manageable crisis as he passed the warm copper baton to Hector.
